brief:
An Israeli attack on an apartment in Gaza City killed a senior Palestinian security official, his wife, and two daughters aged 13 and 15, Middle East Eye reported. The strike struck the residential building as part of ongoing military operations in the enclave.

The incident marks another instance of civilian casualties amid the broader conflict between Israeli forces and Palestinian armed groups in Gaza.
dek: Morning update Good morning Middle East Eye readers, Here are the latest developments: An Israeli attack on an apartment in Gaza City has killed a senior Palestinian security official alongside his wife and two daughters, aged 13 and 15.
title: Israeli strike kills Palestinian security official and family in Gaza City
